published: True

## Quick Summary: 📝
Global Threat Map is a real-time situational awareness platform that visualizes security events, geopolitical developments, and threat indicators on an interactive map. It functions as an OSINT command center, providing detailed country intelligence, military base visualization, and an alert system.

## Key Takeaways: 💡

* ✅ A real-time global event mapping and situational awareness platform for OSINT.

* ✅ Features detailed country intelligence, including AI-powered conflict analysis and historical data.

* ✅ Includes a military bases layer and robust map visualization options like clustering and heatmaps.

* ✅ Offers 'Intel Dossiers' for in-depth research and a configurable alert system for real-time notifications.

* ✅ Built with a modern tech stack (Next.js, Mapbox, Valyu) making it highly extensible and a great learning resource.


## Project Statistics: 📊
* ⭐ **Stars:** 1771
* 🍴 **Forks:** 295
* ❗ **Open Issues:** 21


## Tech Stack: 💻
- ✅ TypeScript


Hey fellow developers and tech enthusiasts! Ever wished you had a bird's-eye view of global events unfolding in real-time? Imagine a tool that aggregates security incidents, geopolitical shifts, and threat indicators onto a single, interactive map. Well, stop imagining, because I just stumbled upon a GitHub project that's exactly that, and it's absolutely mind-blowing! I'm talking about the 'Global Threat & Event Intelligence Map' – an open-source intelligence (OSINT) command center that feels straight out of a spy movie.This project isn't just another pretty map; it's a powerful platform designed for real-time situational awareness. At its core, it plots breaking news events like conflicts, protests, and natural disasters directly onto a dark-themed Mapbox GL JS map. What's truly cool is how it visualizes data: you get color-coded threat levels, event clustering for cleaner views at lower zoom levels, and even a heatmap to visualize event density. Navigating this map is incredibly smooth, making it a joy to explore.But it goes much deeper than just event plotting. The project includes a real-time, filterable event feed, allowing you to quickly find exactly what you're looking for by category or threat level. For those who need to dig deeper, the 'Intel Dossiers' feature is a game-changer. You can build comprehensive research reports on any actor, complete with CSV data exports and even PowerPoint briefings. And for critical developments, the alert system lets you configure keyword and region-based notifications so you're always in the loop.What truly sets this project apart is its rich country intelligence. Click on any country, and you're immediately presented with detailed insights into its historical and current conflicts. We're talking wars, military engagements, border disputes, civil unrest – all presented in a clear, tabbed interface. The best part? This conflict data is synthesized using AI-powered analysis from the Valyu Answer API, complete with cited sources, giving you reliable and actionable intelligence. Plus, the map dynamically highlights the selected country, making the interaction super intuitive.And if you're into military geopolitics, you'll love the dedicated Military Bases Layer. It visualizes global military presence, plotting US military bases as green markers and NATO installations as blue markers. You can click on any base to see its name, type, and host country. It's an incredible way to understand global power projection at a glance.For us developers, the benefits are immense. If you're working on projects related to international relations, security analysis, data visualization, or even just looking for a robust example of a modern full-stack application, this is it. Built with Next.js 16 (App Router), Mapbox GL JS, Tailwind CSS, Zustand for state management, and powered by the Valyu intelligence API, it's a testament to modern web development best practices. Getting started is straightforward with clear prerequisites and installation steps. Imagine the possibilities for integrating this into your own tools or simply using it as a fantastic learning resource! This project is a shining example of how open-source can empower us to build truly impactful applications. You absolutely need to check it out and contribute if you can!
